chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Al-A'ala ibn Razin, from Umar ibn Yazeed, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'Did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) perform Hajj other than the Farewell Hajj?' He (peace be upon him) said, 'Yes, twenty Hajjs.'
ai.seo_question: How many times did the Prophet Muhammad perform Hajj before the Farewell Pilgrimage?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the Prophet’s (saww) consistent observance of the Hajj ritual, with Imam al-Sadiq (as) specifying a total of twenty pilgrimages, a figure often interpreted by Shia scholars to include both the obligatory Hajj and additional voluntary ones. This detail underscores the Prophet’s role as the perfect exemplar of ritual devotion, reinforcing the theological importance of Hajj in Shia jurisprudence as a pillar of faith that was meticulously practiced and taught by the Ahl al-Bayt.
